  • What Is a Hidden State? The Residual Stream, Read and Written2026-10-25 · 12 audio chapters

    When you copy a hidden state out of a language model, what have you copied? We build the answer from vector addition: a running sum that every part of the model writes into and reads from. Then we turn it into a probe, a push and a rotation with toy numbers, hold Olah's three claims as bets, and read the picture through linear algebra and information theory. Two notebooks check the sum on GPT-2 small and say what was not run.

  • Could a society run itself on AI?2026-10-18 · 14 audio chapters

    A society that runs on AI with no human stepping in: is it possible, what would it do, and what would it mean? We split the question into five jobs (run, decide, check, declare, answer) and test each in finance, the most automated corner of society, through control theory, complex systems, Searle's social ontology and political science, with toy models you can break.
